correctness.rationale: Every original even 2×2 block is one 4-bit state a∈0..15. In the inspected original Critters rule each f(a) complements occupation and permutes block patterns. A fixed full even+odd step is exactly a cyclic word satisfying 16-state local conditions f(X(a,b))=Y(a,b) for adjacent original block labels, so Fm(u)=tr[diag(u^{|a|})M]^m, with no missing phase or quotient. The source SymPy program constructs all 256 edge possibilities and derives exact determinant (1−u²z)^5 [1−(1+u²+u⁴)z+(u⁴−u²−u⁶)z²−u⁶z³]. Independently rebuilt the 16-state graph (30 edges), checked 8-state primitive SCC and its (1−u²z)Q determinant, four other singleton loops, traces at m=2..5 (16,44,136,448), and reciprocal polynomial symmetry. PF analytic simple dominant root λ from X³−3X²−X−1 yields exact entropy and Gaussian quasi-powers, ψ'(0)=2, ψ''(0)=2.6898249; variance linear. Independent exhaustive C++ original-update source supports m=2..5; it is not an all-length proof.
